title: 您也是辛苦了
concept: overworked gold sneaker with tiny towel and sweat drop
revised_prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: TripPet iOS achievement medal art candidate for achievement_medal_steps_tier_001, transparent PNG source after chroma-key removal
Primary request: Create one absurd but simple premium collectible steps achievement medal for the Chinese achievement title concept "您也是辛苦了" (you really worked hard too). The image itself must contain no text.
Scene/backdrop: perfectly flat solid #ff00ff chroma-key background for background removal; one uniform color only, no shadows, gradients, texture, floor plane, checkerboard, or lighting variation.
Subject: exactly one centered circular collectible medal, full object visible with generous padding. The medal has a chunky beveled gold rim and glossy mint-teal enamel center. Main visual gag: ONE shiny gold sneaker looking dramatically overworked, with a tiny white sweat towel draped over it and one oversized glossy sweat drop as a lighting/emoji-like effect. The sneaker is the dominant shape; towel is secondary. Keep it low-tier and simple.
Style/medium: polished mobile game collectible, semi-3D hand-painted enamel pin / toy medal hybrid, deliberately silly but premium, raised metal relief, crisp edges, shiny highlights, not photorealistic.
Composition/framing: very simple large readable silhouette, sneaker centered and dominant, no extra step trail. Low detail enough for future steps tiers to become much wilder.
Lighting/mood: bright studio rim light, candy-like specular highlights, comedic over-serious sympathy for a tired shoe.
Color palette: saturated metallic gold, mint/electric teal enamel, white towel, clear blue sweat drop, small coral accent only on the rim, white glints. Do not use #ff00ff anywhere in the medal or subject.
Materials/textures: raised gold metal, glossy enamel, lacquered toy-like surfaces, soft towel, beveled rim, subtle hand-painted shading. No paper grain.
Text: none.
Constraints: no letters, no numbers, no Chinese, no labels, no watermark, no people, no animals, no maps, no route line, no compass, no leaves, no ticket, no postcards, no mailbox, no gold bars, no coins, no money pile, no confetti, no postage stamp edge, no paper texture, no vintage scrapbook look, no cast shadow, no contact shadow, no reflection, do not create multiple medals.
